messages:
maya: Morning team — quick triage pulse. Open queue: 38 total (2 P1, 7 P2). Backlog down ~5% vs yesterday. Notable: EU webhook duplicates still trending up, onboarding flow transfer (ticket 7281) is on the hotlist, billing duplicate charge (7320) needs followup. I updated a refund macro draft — see PR below.

omar: Seeing the duplicate events too. Retries appear to be doubling for a subset of customers hitting eu-webhook-proxy. Logs show intermittent 503s from proxy -> upstream. I captured sample payloads.

sasha: I pushed a small edit to the refund/refund_standard macro to clarify instructions and add an escalation checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/145 — includes new `dup_webhook_notice` template.

jordan: @sre_oncall can you take a look at eu-proxy 503s? If that's the root cause we should tell customers to ignore duplicates until it's fixed. ETA?

sre_oncall: looking now. Preliminary: suspect rate-limiter misconfig on eu-proxy instance group after last deploy. I temporarily bumped the limiter to 2x for the EU pool; watching metrics. Expect reduction in duplicates within ~10m if that's it. Will follow up in incidents channel.

triage-bot: Automated stats: avg first-response 1.1h, SLA breaches (24h): 3. Hotlist count: 4. New tickets in last hour: 6.

maya: Thanks. Action items: 1) @omar upload sample events to shared storage (so SRE can replay) 2) @sasha please finalize PR wording and include rollback steps 3) @jordan hold on billing ticket 7320 until payments-esc confirms. Also create/update macro `dup_webhook_notice` with clear customer-facing guidance.

omar: Samples uploaded: /shared/support/eu-webhook-samples.zip. Reassigning billing ticket 7320 to payments-esc now.

sasha: I'll merge the macro PR after a quick second pass; added an explicit step: "If duplicates persist after 30m, escalate to SRE with sample payloads."

jordan: Quick CR ping: PR #145 needs one more approval for wording. @maya mind a quick thumbs/approve?

maya: Reviewed, left two tiny copy nits, will approve in 5.

triage-bot: Pinned message: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/145 — macro draft for webhook duplicates.

maya: Closing the loop here — we'll reconvene at 10:30AM PT to recheck queue and duplicate rate. If anything spikes, please ping :pager: in #incidents. :thumbsup:
